title: Northstar SDK quickstart visuals: auth, key management, streaming, and tool-calling
creator: Evelyn Park
description: Create a compact, developer-oriented visual asset set for the SDK/API quickstart that covers four core flows: 1) Authentication (token and API key creation + best practices), 2) Key rotation and least-privilege examples, 3) Streaming responses (client SDK streaming UI and server-side considerations), and 4) Tool-calling (structured outputs and example tool invocation flow). Deliverables: Figma frames (desktop + mobile), export-ready PNG/SVG icons and annotated screenshots, one 6-slide walkthrough deck for docs team, and a set of copy-ready alt text strings for accessibility. Acceptance criteria: assets uploaded to the shared Drive with clear naming, assets referenced in docs PR (#GH-1147), design review approval from PM and Eng, and a short implementation checklist for Engineering to capture exact viewport sizes and asset dimensions.
